name: walkorbit_shirt_burgundy
prompt: Five two-second shots joined by instant hard cuts, each from its own fixed camera. The man is walking from the very first moment and walks on the spot the whole time, never turning, always facing the same way. Within a shot the camera is locked to him: it never zooms, pans, tilts or circles, so he stays the same size in the same place in the picture. Every camera stands high above at the same distance and never comes down to eye level: in every shot, as in the first frame, we look down onto the top of his head and his shoulders. The cameras go round his left side only: shot 1 from the front, as in the first frame; shot 2 front-left, he faces towards us and to the picture's left; shot 3 his left side, he faces the picture's left; shot 4 back-left, he faces away from us and to the picture's left; shot 5 straight behind. Quick, short steps, three every second, never a run; his left and right legs take turns exactly alike, each foot lifting for as long and stepping as far as the other. Drawn throughout in the first frame's style, with its dark outlines and flat colours, never a soft 3D render. Flat chroma-key blue background.
